# Split by service time

`customer_support.pb.queue_management.split_by_service_time` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Separate predictable, fast work from investigative, slow work into distinct lines before attempting to balance anything.

Mixing service times in one line is the single cheapest way to make a queue worse: the variance of the slow work is inflicted on all of the fast work, and neither population can be given an honest expectation.
